title: DIO repeated-verify test pins replay barrier only via rejection reason string
description: In python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py test_repeated_dio_time_verify_same_counter_rejected (~line 468), the boolean 'assert not state.consider(option, sample=second)' is satisfiable by an insecure implementation: the first consider() adopted a sample with the same observed_monotonic (both verifies read the same detached.received_monotonic, time_sync.py:444), so _adopt_claimed_locked's stale-or-duplicate check (stratum.py:678-679) rejects even if the entire network replay barrier were deleted. Only the exact 'network-replay-counter-not-new' reason assertion discriminates. Strengthen the pin (e.g. assert the reason, or make the second verify use a fresh receipt time).
